label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: On 21 Oct Shashi Prasad K raised four epics to group the October work (Data Governance, Automation Testing, Chatbot Integration and Magento Upgrade, MT-1741 to MT-1744), so far with no owner. In the Magento 2.4.9 upgrade (MT-1615, due 31 Oct), nine Amasty module subtasks were dated 30 Oct and shubham kuchwar started two of them; upgrade environment support (MT-1654) and Mirasvit_Core (MT-1677) started, and k.kishore was given the infrastructure readiness task (IN-1181, due 26 Oct). 51 of the 91 subtasks are still unassigned. A new Marketplace bug was raised for Naveen Jangid: logging out of one application does not log the user out of the others (MT-1745). 14 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Kunal Jangid closed the review of the new Figma designs (MR-1377) and started the v1.2 marketing site revamp based on the 19 Oct designs (MR-1379, due 30 Oct), including home page design updates (MR-1381); two mobile fixes closed (MR-1371, MR-1372) and four new mobile and GDPR-page fixes were raised for 30 Oct. Saurabh Jain holds review and deployment (MR-1391, due 30 Oct). Five epics were raised with no owner (Design Revamp, Communications, SEO, Identity, Automation Testing, MR-1383 to MR-1387). Vishnu kumar yadav's Sonar fixes MR-1365 and MR-1366 passed their 20 Oct date in Dev, so 14 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Silviu Oltean and Livian Stefan Stan deployed four dashboard and Communication Hub stories to Dev: the support card (USP-4338), the account team card with chat and meeting booking (USP-4339), the explore-services card (USP-4340) and the department-and-role staff structure (USP-4320); staff avatars (USP-4293), subscription state-change visibility (USP-4277) and the invoice search fix (USP-3880) also reached Dev. 116 items are past due; the CRM team assignment (USP-4312) is still in BLOCKER, and the S1 bugs (USP-4231, USP-4204) and the Highest security bug with no due date (USP-4369) remain open.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Ankit Saxena moved the live agent console and handoff queue (UC-21) and its four subtasks (UC-41, UC-42, UC-84, UC-85) to UAT Testing on 21 Oct, re-dated to 21 Oct. The Marketplace user-context check (UC-241) and the handoff-options bug (UC-391, now with Kannan Elangovan) are also in UAT. Internal knowledge-base and demand-tracking items moved from 23 to 26 Oct, and Shivam Dhoundiyal started the UI 2.0 mock-up (UC-392, due 22 Oct). 26 items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Naveen Jangid started the verification step of CI build reproducibility (PULSE-280, due 27 Oct); the define step (PULSE-278) passed its 20 Oct date in progress, the programme's one past-due item. Sarath Chandra renewed the TLS certificate on the on-premises VM (PULSE-334). Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: Ahead of the 22 October demo, Saurabh Jain started agent orchestration, scoring and handoff (ATLAS-286) and Gourav Agnani the demo journey and synthetic lead data (ATLAS-284). Nagamuni Valluri finished local set-up (ATLAS-294) and started the M0 app shell and Carbon UI kit (ATLAS-20, ATLAS-36). Of the 295 ATLAS tickets, 267 are unassigned and 293 have no due date.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: Yash Janeshwar moved two JWT and session assessment subtasks to Dev Testing (ID-722, ID-723) and started the MFA-recovery and federation-session reviews (ID-724, ID-725). Saravana Kumar started the Rafay SSO integration (ID-762) and the account-deactivation API in the delete-account flow (ID-765), and r.jaiswal started detailed testing of account deactivation (ID-769). Gourav Agnani's Socket.IO SSO logout test (ID-761) is in UAT. 6 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: The production chatbot task for Azure Communication Services and Entra permissions (IN-1178, Sarath Chandra, due 21 Oct) moved to BLOCKER; the same task is in progress on the Web-Identity board with k.kishore (ID-766, due 22 Oct). Sarath Chandra fixed the Conversational AI repo branch configuration and the UAT Key Vault settings (IN-1182, IN-1183). k.kishore was given Magento 2.4.9 infrastructure readiness (IN-1181, due 26 Oct). 16 items sit in BLOCKER status and 20 are past due; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: Shashi Prasad K fixed the homepage redirect chain so http://www.uvation.com goes straight to the HTTPS site (DM-1093), and raised a new item: 29 Marketplace product pages return HTTP 410 and need redirects (DM-1096, not started). The 404 work (DM-1082, due 28 Oct) and the H1-tag fix (DM-1091) are in review. 27 items are past due.
